survey: Blue sports water bottle floating over a sunburst, tilted ~13° to the right. Body: waisted cylinder whose two side contours share one direction (~77°), bottom contour bulges downward and the base shows through the translucent plastic as a fairly open ellipse – consistent with a camera slightly above. Cap: ribbed screw cap seated coaxially on the neck; its bands (~166°) run perpendicular to the body axis; its top face is just visible, seen from above. Spout: small cylinder on top of the cap, parallel to the bottle axis, top opening a narrow ellipse seen from above; ellipses open up toward the base as expected for a camera above. Loop handle: ring tab on the cap's right side, its plane facing the viewer so the hole reads nearly circular – plausible for a side tab, thickness and attachment agree with the cap. Body bands and the swoosh wrap around the cylinder smoothly and follow its tilt. No ground plane, so no contact to check. All parts agree on one viewpoint.
